To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the feature kernel of a trained NN is highly dependent on initialisation and (2) KD with the feature kernel improves NN generalisation in multi-view settings, and can be improved by our novel approach, Feature Kernel Distillation
• Feature kernel distillation is a novel KD approach that can improve the generalization of a student model by using only pairwise feature kernels.

(1) the NN’s feature kernel can be used as a knowledge distillation signal to improve generalization, and (2) the feature kernel can be distilled in a novel way, which outperforms other feature kernel based distillation baselines
In summary, our research is concerned with

the question: How can we improve NN generalisation via Knowledge Distillation (i.e., training a student NN to mimic the output of a teacher NN), and we provide a theoretical & empirical framework for answering this question.
improving the generalisation of knowledge distillation in the image classification task.
understanding the feature kernel of NNs, and how to leverage this understanding to improve the generalisation properties of NNs through KD.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we show that feature kernels can be used for KD and we propose a novel KD method that uses feature kernels, which outperforms other KD methods.
the feature kernel is a useful mechanism to improve the generalisation of knowledge distillation in multi-view data settings.
our theory shows that the feature kernel is a key factor for generalisation and distillation, and we propose a simple and effective method for using this to improve generalisation in KD.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
(i) we show that feature kernel is highly data-dependent, (ii) this data-dependency can be leveraged for knowledge distillation, and (iii) we show how to leverage it for better distillation.
we propose a novel approach for knowledge distillation, called feature kernel distillation, that can be used to improve generalisation of the student model in multi-view data settings.
the feature kernel is an important and under-utilised component of NNs, and that distilling it can be a powerful approach for improving student generalization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the feature kernel can be used to transfer knowledge across different NN architectures, datasets, and even initialisation settings.
the feature kernel can be a powerful tool for KD, and that it can provide a principled way to improve student generalisation.

, by using the feature kernel as a distillation signal, we can improve NN test generalisation, and this improvement is particularly prominent in the multi-view data setting, where the feature kernel is most sensitive to initialisation.
